_comment: Tutorial cards (src/systems/tutorialManager.js). Each one comes up the first time its trigger fires (the game's situations and events, listed in `events`; the ones in `situations` are re-checked a few times a second and their tips only show while still true), or when a campaign objective asks for it by id (`tutorial` on an objective in campaign_quests.json). `after` chains them (the onboarding: on foot -> cars -> driving -> map and jobs). Steps with `do` are practice: they tick off when you do the action (listed in `actions`). {Key} renders as a key cap. where: play (on the street), battle, menu, any.

tutorials.title: On foot
tutorials.intro: Welcome to the city. Try these out:

steps.text: Walk with {W} {A} {S} {D}
steps.touch: Walk: put your left thumb down anywhere on the left and drag

steps.text: Look around with the {Mouse} (click the game first to capture it)
steps.touch: Look around: drag anywhere on the right

steps.text: Hold {Shift} to sprint
steps.touch: Push the stick all the way out to sprint

steps.text: Press {Space} to jump
steps.touch: Tap the jump button to jump; swipe it to roll

steps.text: Hold {Alt} to crouch: low and quiet, wild Streetmon and heist guards notice you less
steps.touch: Push the stick only a little to crouch: low and quiet, wild Streetmon and heist guards notice you less

steps.text: Walk up to any car and press {E} (or {F}) to get in
steps.touch: Tap any car: you walk over and get in

steps.text: Someone at the wheel? You'll pull them out: that's carjacking, a crime if anyone sees it
Parked cars are free to take
{W} to accelerate, {S} to brake and reverse
steps.touch: Push the stick forward to accelerate, pull it back to brake and reverse

steps.text: {A} {D} to steer
steps.touch: Push the stick sideways to steer

steps.text: {Space} for the handbrake: slide round corners
steps.touch: Hold the handbrake button: slide round corners

steps.text: {H} for the horn
steps.touch: Tap your car for the horn (and the camera)

steps.text: {E} or {F} to get out
steps.touch: Tap your car, then the door, to get out

tutorials.title: The map and your first job
tutorials.intro: There's work in this city. The yellow M on the minimap (on its edge when it's far) is someone with a job for you.

steps.text: Press {M} for the city map
steps.touch: Tap the minimap for the city map

steps.text: Click the M to set a waypoint: a route shows on the road and the minimap
Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, right-click clears the waypoint, {M} or {Esc} closes
steps.touch: Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, tap a spot for a waypoint; Close shuts it

steps.text: Drive there and press {E} next to them to talk
steps.touch: Go there and tap them to talk

steps.text: Press {E} next to someone with an M over their head
steps.touch: Tap someone with an M over their head to talk

steps.text: Answer with {1} to {4} (or click). Accepting starts the job
A tick over their head means a job's ready to hand in: talk to them again
Your job and its next step show in the panel at the top right
The yellow beacon and the ring on the ground mark where to go
Got several jobs? {J} switches which one you're tracking
A failed job (out of time, busted, wasted) can be taken again from whoever gave it
Some jobs need a car: drive into the ring to pick up or drop off
The timer starts at the pickup. Run out and the job fails
Getting busted or wasted on the way loses the cargo: the job fails
Set a waypoint on the drop-off ({M}, click) for a route
steps.touch: Set a waypoint on the drop-off (tap the minimap, then the spot) for a route

tutorials.title: Wild Streetmon
tutorials.intro: The coloured dots on the minimap are wild Streetmon (the colour is their type).

steps.text: Walk up to one and press {B} to battle it with your lead Streetmon
steps.touch: Tap one, then the crossed swords, to battle it with your lead Streetmon

steps.text: Point at a Streetmon to see its health bar and level
Sneak up crouched ({Alt}): shy ones run if they hear you, aggressive ones attack
steps.touch: Sneak up with a light push on the stick: shy ones run if they hear you, aggressive ones attack

tutorials.title: Battles
tutorials.intro: Turn-based: you pick, then the moves play out.

steps.text: {1} Fight: pick a move ({1} to {4}). Coloured badges are the move's type
{2} Team: switch in another Streetmon
{3} Bag: throw a capture item (wild Streetmon only)
{4} Run (not from trainers, bosses or the police). {Space} speeds up the text
Prefer action? Pause ({Esc}) and switch Battles to Real-time
steps.touch: Prefer action? Pause and switch Battles to Real-time

steps.text: {1} to {4}: use a move (your Streetmon acts when its bar fills)
steps.touch: Tap a move on the wheel (bottom right) to use it: your Streetmon acts when the ring round the attack button fills

steps.text: Keep moving: you're free to walk around and dodge
{5} swaps your Streetmon, {X} flees, {C} throws a capture item
steps.touch: Top left: swap your Streetmon, flee, throw a capture item

steps.text: {LMB} shoots or hits the foe with your weapon too
steps.touch: The crosshair button fires at (or hits) the foe with your weapon too

steps.text: {T} switches the number keys to your weapons (and back to commands)
steps.touch: The keys button swaps the wheel for your weapons (and back)

tutorials.title: Types
tutorials.intro: Every Streetmon and every move has a type. Hitting the right type does double damage.

steps.text: Concrete beats Gun, Gun beats Bass, Bass beats Concrete
Grind beats Concrete and Smoke; Smoke beats Gun and Grind
Rooftop Wire beats Grind, Bass and Sludge; sewer Sludge beats Gun and Concrete
{N} opens your Dex: it lists every species you've seen and caught
steps.touch: Tap yourself, then the i, for your Dex: it lists every species you've seen and caught

tutorials.title: Catching
tutorials.intro: It's weak: now's the time to catch it.

steps.text: In a battle: {3} Bag, then pick an item. The lower its health, the better the chance
Outside battles: face a wild Streetmon and press {C} to throw. {V} switches item
steps.touch: Outside battles: tap a wild Streetmon, then the capture ball, to throw. Tap your team bar to pick the item

steps.text: Cuffs, Crates and Nets are sold at the Corner Clinic (green on the minimap)
Missed? Every miss on the same Streetmon makes the next throw likelier, and a long losing streak gives items back
{I} opens your team: up to 6 travel with you, the rest go to the stash
steps.touch: Tap yourself, then the team icon: up to 6 travel with you, the rest go to the stash

steps.text: The first one is your lead: it fights first and follows you around
{G} summons or recalls your lead on foot
steps.touch: Tap yourself, then the paw, to bring out or recall your lead

steps.text: Streetmon level up from battles, learn moves and can evolve
Your team is full (6), so new catches go to the stash
Swap them in and out from the team screen ({I})
steps.touch: Swap them in and out from the team screen (tap yourself, then the team icon)

steps.text: Your Streetmon is evolving: bigger, stronger, sometimes a new type
Press {B} to stop it if you'd rather it stayed as it is
Some only evolve with an item: the Skyline Trader on the rooftops sells them
Hurt Streetmon stay hurt. Corner Clinics (green squares on the minimap) heal the whole team for a fee
Press {E} at the clinic. It sells capture items too
If all your Streetmon faint you black out and wake up at a clinic, a bit poorer
A gang trainer has spotted you (the ! over their head). You can't run from this one
Beat them for cash. They won't challenge you again
Trainers are the red-pink dots on the minimap: steer clear if your team is hurt
{B} next to a person sets your lead on them. It's a crime: witnesses call the police
steps.touch: Tap a person, then the crossed swords, to set your lead on them. It's a crime: witnesses call the police

steps.text: Get busted after that and animal control takes the Streetmon to the impound
Hold {RMB} to aim
steps.touch: Tap the aim button to raise the gun (tap again to lower it); the view eases onto targets near the crosshair

steps.text: {LMB} to fire (or swing, or throw)
steps.touch: Hold the attack button to fire (or swing, or throw)

steps.text: {R} to reload
steps.touch: The reload button reloads (it shows when the magazine is not full)

steps.text: {1} to {8}, the mouse wheel or {Q} switch weapons
steps.touch: Tap your weapon (bottom middle) to switch weapons

steps.text: Hold {Tab} for the weapon wheel
steps.touch: Tap your weapon to switch; tap your team bar for the quick wheel

steps.text: Press {E} to browse weapons and ammo
Gun shops are the amber squares on the minimap. Weapons and cash also lie around the streets (small yellow and green dots)
Firing a gun where people can see is a crime

tutorials.title: Wanted
tutorials.intro: The stars at the top right are your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Crimes someone sees earn stars: hitting people, carjacking, gunfire, speeding past a patrol car
Get out of sight. When the stars blink, they're searching the circle on the minimap
Stay hidden until the stars run out. The sewers are a good place to lie low
Stop or slow down near an officer and you get arrested: busted
Three stars: the police ram you and bring tranquilliser darts
Four: roadblocks ahead of you. Five: tanks
The Chop Shop won't open while the cops are on you
The police set a K-9 Streetmon on you. Win and you can run for it
Lose and you're busted
You lose your weapons and a tenth of your cash, and you're let out at the precinct
Any job, race or heist you were on is off
Streetmon used in crimes were confiscated
Get them back at the precinct impound (purple on the minimap): $150 each, {E} there
You wake up back on the street with a hospital bill (up to $100)
Any job, race or heist you were on is off. The police forget about you
Press {R} to flip the car back onto its wheels
steps.touch: Tap the action button to flip the car back onto its wheels

steps.text: {G} turns the siren on and off
steps.touch: Tap your car, then the star, for the siren

steps.text: Stealing one is a crime, and every cop knows the car

tutorials.title: Bitten!
tutorials.intro: An aggressive Streetmon is on you, and it hurts.

steps.text: Press {B} to battle it
steps.touch: Tap it, then the crossed swords, to battle it

steps.text: Or run far enough that it gives up
Or get out of its sight: round a corner, behind a building
People hunt Streetmon too, and wild ones fight over turf
{B} on a Streetmon someone else is battling takes it over. They won't be pleased
steps.touch: Tap a Streetmon someone else is battling, then the crossed swords, to take it over. They won't be pleased

steps.text: Explosions and speeding cars scatter everything nearby
More wild Streetmon are out at night, and some species only come out after dark
Some races are night-only
Stand on the cover and press {E} to climb down into the sewers
Manholes you've used stay on the minimap
No police down here, and the trail goes cold twice as fast
Keep out of the toxic sludge and the steam vents; the channels push you along
People live down here: press {E} to talk, some have work. Sludge-type Streetmon too
Ladders ({E}) take you back up to the street
Press {E} at a fire escape or a lobby elevator to go up to the rooftops
Jump pads launch you across the gaps. Mind the edge: a fall can kill you
Stashes hide on the roofs ({E} to open). Some are well hidden
The Skyline Trader sells evolution items. Wire-type Streetmon and gang trainers live up here too

tutorials.title: The Underground Chop Shop
tutorials.intro: Streetmon can ride in your car and power it up.

steps.text: The Chop Shop is the pink marker. Drive onto the lift and press {E}
It won't open while you're wanted
Inside, slot Streetmon into the engine bay, trunk and roof rack: each type gives different mods and abilities
{1} to {3} pick a slot (engine bay, trunk, roof rack), then a Streetmon from your team or stash
The stats bar shows the change: top speed, acceleration, grip, durability...
Some mods add an ability with a key, shown when you drive. Slotted Streetmon stay with the car
Abilities from your mods: {Shift} Nitrous Smokescreen, {H} Sonic Bass Horn, {X} Spike Strip
Some work on their own: Exhaust Backfire when you crash, the radar's extra range
Tuned cars are pale pink on the minimap when you leave them parked
{Y} takes the race (and pays the entry fee), {Backspace} turns it down
steps.touch: The action button takes the race (and pays the entry fee); drive on to turn it down

steps.text: Drive to the start line and stop on it to start
Organisers wait at the orange markers. Dim ones need more Street Cred
Follow the yellow line and hit every checkpoint
{R} flips you back over; {Backspace} quits the race
Winning pays out and earns Street Cred

tutorials.title: The USRL
tutorials.intro: The Underground Street Racing League ranks you in divisions.

steps.text: Street Cred (from races, events and jobs) and the bosses you beat move you up a division
Higher divisions open more tracks: bigger prizes, bigger entry fees
Some story races put the police on you the moment they start
Purple markers are jobs. Press {E} at the spot to plan one
Pick a crew of up to 3 Streetmon for the job's roles (each job needs some, others are optional)
Get in, breach ({E}), grab the bags ({E}), then lose the cops and deliver to the green lock-up
{Backspace} walks away from a job
steps.touch: Tap yourself, then the runner, to walk away from a job

steps.text: Each role takes certain types (shown on the role). Strong stats make them better at it
Breacher: opens the vault or doors (no Breacher is slow)
Hacker: {Z} jams the cameras and alarm. Smoke: {X} knocks out nearby guards. Hauler: carries loot bags for you
steps.touch: Hacker: the keypad button jams the cameras and alarm. Smoke: the mask button knocks out nearby guards. Hauler: carries loot bags for you

steps.text: Stay out of sight of guards and cameras: they raise the alarm
Breach points are yellow on the minimap, loot bags green
Loot is heavy: the more you carry, the slower you go, and above 28 kg you can't sprint. A Hauler in the crew takes some
The lock-up only opens with no stars on you
Red and orange markers are events: armoured trucks, Streetmon outbreaks, supply drops
Stop the truck, clear the outbreak, or get to the crate first and press {E} to pry it open
Rewards: cash, Street Cred, items and upgrade chips. Many bring the police
A red skull marks a crew boss. Press {E} next to them to start the fight
Bosses bring a full team. Heal at a clinic first and bring types that beat theirs
Lose and you black out, but the job stays on: come back and try again
Wild Streetmon dots on the minimap are coloured by their type
Some types live in certain districts, the sewers or on the roofs; others only come out at night
Your Dex ({N}) shows where you first saw each species
steps.touch: Your Dex (tap yourself, then the i) shows where you first saw each species

steps.text: Break line of sight: side streets, tunnels, round corners
Drop down a manhole: no police in the sewers
A tuned car helps: smokescreens and spike strips
Getting busted fails the job
Street Cred comes from winning races, street events and jobs
Districts remember what you did there
The game saves itself as you play
{Esc} pauses: save, export a save file, turn sound, shadows and these tips on or off, or replay any tip
steps.touch: The pause button (top right): save, export a save file, turn sound, shadows and these tips on or off, or replay any tip

steps.text: {K} mutes the sound
A legendary Streetmon is rampaging! Its stomps knock out wild Streetmon, throw cars and people, and flatten the street
Stay out of the shock ring when it stomps, or it will flatten you too
Trainers nearby come running to help. Their Streetmon wear it down while you get close
Walk up to it and press {B} to fight it with them. It's tough and attacks twice as often as anything else, so bring your best team
steps.touch: Tap it, then the crossed swords, to fight it with them. It's tough and attacks twice as often as anything else, so bring your best team

steps.text: Leave it too long and it moves on. The bar at the top shows its HP and how long you have
The trainers' Streetmon fight beside yours. They pick their own moves
It can't be caught mid-fight. Beat it first
Lose or run and it keeps the damage you did, so you can go again
It's subdued, but only for a moment!
Face it and throw a capture item with {C}. Your odds are better than usual right now
steps.touch: Tap it, then the capture ball, to throw. Your odds are better than usual right now

steps.text: Keep throwing until the timer at the top runs out
